caseSensitive.description:
Match case exactly. Defaults to false: ASCII letters then match either
case; every other character always matches exactly.

includeIgnored.description:
Also search files a `.gitignore` excludes. Defaults to false: they are
skipped and counted in `skipped`. Denied and unindexed paths are never
searched either way.

maxResults.description: At most this many matches; absent means the server default.

pathPrefix.description:
Search only this file or directory (project-relative, forward
slashes). The result's `scope` says whether it could be searched.

query.description: The literal text to find. No regular expressions; no line breaks.

target.description: What to search. Defaults to file text.

SearchTarget.description: Inbound-only, but `Serialize` too so the schema shows the default.
